code: @keyframes aperiodicPulse { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(255, 50, 150, 0.1); transform: scale(1); } 37% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 50px rgba(50, 200, 255, 0.3); transform: scale(1.01) skewX(0.2deg); } 73% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 30px rgba(255, 100, 50, 0.2); transform: scale(0.99) skewY(-0.2deg); } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 25px rgba(200, 50, 255, 0.15); transform: scale(1); } } body { animation: aperiodicPulse 11s infinite alternate cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1); }
